newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Block of 28 mln Heshe shares crossed.
newsitem.headline: Block of 28 mln Heshe shares crossed.

text.p: A block of 28 million shares in retail and garment manufacturer Heshe Holdings Ltd was crossed off the market at Singapore $0.40 each on Monday, dealers said.
They said the trade was probably a previously announced placement of new shares in the company.
Heshe said in October it had agreed to place out privately 28 million new shares via securities firm Ong & Co.
Officials at Heshe were not immediately available to comment on the block deal on Monday.
Heshe shares were up two cents at S$0.415 by 0130 GMT.
